article.summary: A Story About Si Subur - This is a system called “Si Subur.” What does Si Subur mean? In Indonesia, “subur” means fertile, lush, or productive (synonyms include gemuk, gendut, etc.). The “fertility” I want to talk about in this article refers to human fertility.

What I Learned - Redis Keyspace Notification. First of all apa itu redis keyspace notification? sederhanya, ini adalah sebuah publish-subscribe pada redis dimana ketika terjadi sebuah perubahan data pada redis, maka akan terdapat notif.
